text: dsh-o11y-plugin（DSH 插件，web/headless）：为插件提供 OpenTelemetry 可观测性。它注册全局 providers，经 OTLP/HTTP 导出 traces、metrics、logs，并可将 DSH 会话遥测转为 OTel 日志。支持信号独立开关、指标定期导出及 service name 配置，适合需要统一观测插件运行情况的开发者。可设置 collector endpoint；默认使用 localhost:4318，无需 API key。

dsh-o11y-plugin (DSH web/headless plugin) exports OpenTelemetry traces, metrics, and logs over OTLP/HTTP. It can bridge session telemetry into OTel logs and configure signals and the collector endpoint. Default: localhost:4318; no API key needed.
想让 DSH 插件把 OpenTelemetry trace 导出到 collector。
有没有办法统一收集 DSH 插件产生的 metrics？
我想把应用日志用 OpenTelemetry logs 发给本地服务。
让 DSH 的 session telemetry 也进入 OTel 日志管道。
How can my DSH plugins export traces, metrics, and logs through one OTLP endpoint?
I need DSH session telemetry records to show up as OpenTelemetry log records.
怎么给 DSH 扩展加上可配置的链路追踪、指标和日志导出？
Can I set a service name and metric export interval for OpenTelemetry in DSH?
dsh-o11y-plugin 的功能「Trace 导出」：注册全局 tracer provider，将 spans 批量经 OTLP/HTTP 发往 collector；可关闭 traces。
dsh-o11y-plugin 的功能「Metrics 导出」：注册全局 meter provider，按配置的间隔将指标经 OTLP/HTTP 发往 collector；可单独关闭指标导出。
dsh-o11y-plugin 的功能「Logs 导出」：注册全局 OpenTelemetry logger provider，让调用 OTel logs API 生成的日志记录通过 OTLP/HTTP 输出；可独立关闭。
dsh-o11y-plugin 的功能「会话遥测桥接」：监听 session-telemetry/record，将记录映射为 OTel 日志并继续事件链；可关闭桥接。
dsh-o11y-plugin 使用前须知：启用信号导出后，OTel 数据会经 OTLP/HTTP 发往配置的 endpoint；未配置 endpoint 时默认目标为本机 localhost:4318。

dsh-o11y-plugin README · Overview：dsh ships session-level OTel telemetry but exposes no metric or plugin-scoped
observability to plugins. dsh-o11y-plugin converges that gap: it registers
global OpenTelemetry providers so any plugin using the standard
`@opentelemetry/api` exports traces, metrics, and logs through a single,
consistently configured pipeline, and it bridges dsh session telemetry into
OTel logs. It is intended for plugin authors who want standard,
community-compatible observability without implementing OTel per plugin.

|---|---|

| Runtime dependency | `@deepseek-ai/cordis` `4.0.5` only |
| Last verified | unit tests against `@deepseek-ai/cordis` `4.0.5` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` `0.2.1-rc.5` |
| Node | `^22.19 \|\| >=24` |
| Profiles | `headless`, `web` |

dsh-o11y-plugin README · Compatibility：Built on the official OpenTelemetry Node.js SDK, the same dependency family as
dsh's `session-telemetry-otel`.

dsh plugin --profile headless add github:fly3366/dsh-o11y-plugin

dsh-o11y-plugin README · point exports at a collector (optional; silent without one)：OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318 dsh --profile headless "say hi"
```

Any plugin that calls `trace.getTracer(...)` / `metrics.getMeter(...)` /
`logs.getLogger(...)` from `@opentelemetry/api` is then exported automatically.
[deepjit](https://github.com/fly3366/DeepJIT) is the reference consumer,
emitting pipeline counters and GenAI (`gen_ai.*`) LLM spans.

dsh-o11y-plugin README · Configuration：When the host dsh exposes a settings-namespace API (`installSettingsSection` /
`settingsNamespace` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`), the same knobs are
registered as an `o11y` namespace in the dsh Web settings UI, so they can be
viewed and edited there; they persist and apply on the next dsh start.

dsh-o11y-plugin README · Configuration：> dsh `0.1.5` dropped `installSettingsSection` and `0.2.1-rc.5` still lacks it,
> so on those lines the plugin probes for the API and gracefully no-ops — config
> stays file/env-driven. The integration lights up again automatically if a
> future dsh restores it.
>
> A reference Web settings **card** (client half) is parked on the
> `wip/settings-ui` branch. It predates dsh's official client-plugin mechanism
> (`dsh.client` declaration + `/plugins`-served bundles + `ctx.slots.register`,
> shipped in the 0.1.7 line), so reviving it means reworking the card onto that
> contract; it is not shipped on `main`.

dsh-o11y-plugin README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | master switch |
| `serviceName` | `''` (→ `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` → `dsh-plugin`) | OTel resource `service.name` |
| `endpoint` | `''` (→ `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` → `http://localhost:4318`) | OTLP/HTTP endpoint |
| `enableTraces` / `enableMetrics` / `enableLogs` | `true` | per-signal toggles |
| `metricExportIntervalMs` | `60000` | periodic metric export interval |
| `bridgeSessionTelemetry` | `true` | bridge dsh session telemetry into OTel logs |

dsh-o11y-plugin README · Configuration：Sensitive: no credentials are read or stored; only the optional OTLP endpoint is
network-facing.

dsh-o11y-plugin README · Permissions & data：- **Files**: none written; all telemetry is in-memory until exported.
- **Network**: OTLP/HTTP to the configured endpoint only; silent drop when no
  collector is reachable.
- **Credentials**: none.
- **User data**: session-telemetry records are observed in-memory (when
  bridging) and forwarded as OTel logs; nothing is persisted by this plugin.

dsh-o11y-plugin README · Troubleshooting：- No collector at the endpoint → batches are dropped silently (expected). - Export errors → surface via OTel diag; verify `endpoint` and collector availability. - Roll back with `dsh plugin --profile

remove dsh-o11y-plugin` or set `enabled=false`.
